patch_list: Block analytics & tracking

Stops analytics and tracking in the DealSeek app: AppsFlyer, Meta app events, Firebase, TikTok and PostHog. Blocking happens on the device, inside the app. Sign-in and deals are left alone. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Block background location

Removes the app's ability to ask for location while it is closed or in the background, so it cannot notice you arriving at a store, even if you tap Allow all the time. Location while you use the app still works if you allow it. May affect:…
Block Bluetooth scanning

Stops the app from scanning for Bluetooth devices and in-store beacons, and hides your paired devices. Beacon libraries no longer wake the app when the phone starts or charges. May affect: in-store maps and their location dot (Target, The…
Disable auto-updates

Stops the Play Store from silently replacing the patched app with the official version, which would bring the ads back. It raises the app's version number far ahead of the Store's, so the Store sees it as up to date. You can still update o…
Disable Pairip license check
Lets the re-signed app start: Google's Pairip license check otherwise blocks any copy not installed from the Play Store. Client-side only; it does not bypass Play Integrity attestation.
Hide cell tower info

Hides the cell towers your phone sees from the app, which can place you within a few blocks even without location access. Use Spoof carrier to hide the carrier itself. Few app features rely on this. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Hide device identifiers

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Hide Wi-Fi networks

Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of the network you are on from the app, so it cannot tell which store's Wi-Fi is around you. May affect: store detection and store mode, Wi-Fi setup for smart-home devices (Amazon), and fraud checks…
Spoof carrier

Hides your mobile carrier from the app and the ad and analytics SDKs inside it, or reports a carrier name you choose. Carrier deals the app detects from your carrier will not work while this is on. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Strip affiliate links
Opens DealSeek deals at the store's own page. It skips DealSeek's click tracking and the affiliate redirects, and removes affiliate tags such as Amazon's.
